# Market map notices

This directory contains the browser-side assets admitted by Order RMS-PLACES-001.
They are served from Yellow's own origin only; the Market map does not request map
styles, tiles, fonts, analytics, or geocoding from another network origin.

## MapLibre GL JS 6.9.0

The optional renderer is `maplibre-gl@6.9.0`, distributed under the BSD 3-Clause
License. Yellow serves the exact installed package distribution through a fixed server-side
allowlist. It does not expose a filesystem path or third-party asset endpoint. It is loaded only after
an authenticated operator opens Market map. MapLibre globe projection is optional;
the same one 2D engine is used for both projections.

Upstream: <https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/tree/v6.9.0>
License: <https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/blob/v6.9.0/LICENSE.txt>

## Natural Earth land

`ne_110m_land.geojson` is a reduced local land backdrop derived from Natural Earth
Vector 1:110m land. Natural Earth data are public domain under its official terms.
Pinned upstream: `nvkelso/natural-earth-vector` commit
`ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19`, path
`geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson`. Local SHA-256:
`9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9`. It is presentation-only and contains no
hotel, guest, tenant, or market-rate data.

Official terms: <https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/>
